def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    fill_ratio = 1.0 - (remaining / (bins + 1e-9))
    harmonic_bonus = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.abs(fill_ratio - 0.85))
    scores = np.where(valid, harmonic_bonus, -np.inf)
    max_cap = np.max(bins)
    empty_mask = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    if np.any(empty_mask):
        first_empty = np.argmax(empty_mask)
        scores[first_empty] = 0.3
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    max_orig = np.max(bins)
    if max_orig == 0:
        return scores
    ratio = rem / max_orig
    ideal = 0.3
    scores[valid] = np.exp(-((ratio[valid] - ideal) ** 2) / 0.05)
    empty_mask = valid & (bins == max_orig) & (rem == bins - item)
    scores[empty_mask] *= 0.7
    return scores
